title: Pack idea agent: one call per pack, up to three theme ideas, multi-source citation check
description:
New module src/papyrus_content/ideas/pack_stories.py.
- Prompt (design 5.2): propose one to three distinct ideas about the theme, not any single item; carry the rules from monitor_stories.SYSTEM_PROMPT (one sentence per entry, ISO dates only as given, no arithmetic, no present-tense claims about the publisher, say where sources are from, never "desk"). Say which References are pending and that they may not be cited.
- Structured output: ideas[] {headline, dek, section, paragraphs, cites_summary} using trends.SENTENCE_SCHEMA sentences.
- Check with trends.check_sentence (multi-handle): handles exist; numbers/dates appear in the cited handle; each idea cites at least two accepted References; a Message (M#) only together with a Reference; a pending handle (P#) is never cited. A failing idea is dropped, not the pack.
- De-duplicate with dedupe.split_duplicates against published stories, current and spiked ideas and the run's other ideas (fixed 0.5 stays, flagged; S4.3 replaces it).
- Model: GPT-6 Luna via synthesis.openai_transport; cost added to the run's cost meter.
Unit tests with a stub transport: a valid response files 1-3 ideas; an idea citing one Reference is dropped; an idea citing only a pending Reference is dropped.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
